title: Singular genitive: -in → -ime-
summary: Replace final -in with -ime- before -n in this selected family: puhelin (“phone”) → puhelimen.
objectives: Replace final -in with -ime- before -n in this selected family: puhelin (“phone”) → puhelimen.

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: The genitive is a case form. It can link a word to an owner or another noun. Here you practise the word form; later lessons show its uses in sentences.
Replace final -in with -ime- before -n in this selected family. In soitin and keitin, t also strengthens to tt.
keyPoints: Learn the word with its stem; the last letter alone does not identify every pattern.

steps: Replace final -in with -ime-: puhel + ime + n = puhelimen.
The form changes the grammatical use, while the word keeps its basic meaning.
Replace final -in with -ime-: ava + ime + n = avaimen.

Replace final -in with -ime-: elä + ime + n = eläimen.
The form changes the grammatical use, while the word keeps its basic meaning.
Strengthen t to tt and use -ime-: soitin → soittime-; add -n.
